title: incident-bot: oncall autodiagnostics quicklink shortcuts + slo-toolkit utils refactor
author: Asha Patel
description: Adds quicklink shortcuts from SLO alert contexts to relevant runbooks and common remediation steps, refactors shared utilities in slo-toolkit to support scoring and caching of runbook links, and introduces oncall helper commands for compact runbook previews. Motivation: reduce mean time to resolution by surfacing vetted remediation links and ranked runbook snippets directly in oncall flow. Includes unit and integration tests, updated docs, and a small migration helper for persisted quicklink scores.
commits: a1f3e2b: feat: surface top-runbook quicklinks in alert context payload
b7c9f44: refactor(slo-toolkit): extract quicklink scoring + cache layer
d2e4a11: feat(oncall): add 'rb-preview' helper for compact runbook snippets
f5b3c90: test: add unit + e2e tests for quicklink ranking
e8a12b7: docs: update oncall runbook quicklinks section
review_comments: Miguel Ortega: Nice improvement — can we add a small rate-limit around runbook scoring to avoid spikes when many alerts fire?
Asha Patel: Added a 200ms debounce + in-memory LRU cache in quicklinks/cache.ts; updated tests to simulate burst alerts.
Priya Raman: Left one nit on types and asked for clearer error handling when runbook fetch fails.
Asha Patel: Addressed nits, added retry/backoff and clearer log lines; included a compact fallback message when runbook service is unreachable.
Ethan Cole: Verified e2e results in staging, approving once CI is green.
release_notes: Incident-bot: surfaced ranked runbook quicklinks in SLO/oncall context and added 'rb-preview' helper. slo-toolkit: refactored runbook utilities to enable cached scoring and ranking. Non-breaking. Improves oncall MTTR by surfacing targeted remediation links.
notes: Migration: scripts/migrate-quicklink-scores.sh will populate initial cache for high-traffic runbooks; rollout to Dedicated clusters staged via feature flag 'quicklink-ranking' in values.yaml. Observability: added metrics incident_bot.quicklinks.request_count and incident_bot.quicklinks.latency_ms for monitoring.
